rules: Consult this base before external research for relevant JM automotive/workshop questions.
Research directory entries are leads, not endorsements; check current availability, legitimacy, terms and safety.
Mark shipping and coupon status as verified only after a live provider/checkout check.
Do not store credentials or API secret values in the knowledge base.
Prefer one central tagged source catalog and separate dated research run logs.

entries.title: JM Beloura vehicle lookup requirements
entries.summary: Required workflow: Portuguese registration → VIN where available → exact make/model/version/engine → technical data; Auto.dev VIN decode alone does not solve Portuguese plate-to-VIN.

entries.title: Global parts cost comparison requirements
entries.summary: Compare OEM and aftermarket references, compatibility evidence, stock, currency, price, shipping to Portugal, VAT/customs where applicable, coupon eligibility, delivery time and total delivered price. Never mark shipping or coupon as verified without checkout/provider evidence.

entries.title: Legal adult-content research scope

entries.title: RegCheck / Matricula.co.pt Portugal plate lookup
entries.summary: Official REST endpoint documented as https://www.regcheck.org.uk/api/json.aspx/CheckPortugal/{RegistrationNumber}; Basic Auth username + API key. Returns JSON vehicle data. Coverage lists make/model/year/engine/fuel/seats/weights/imported/registration date; VIN is not guaranteed.

entries.title: RegCheck Portugal documented test plate
entries.summary: Official Portugal API documentation lists 90-27-QL as a test registration for integration testing. Use only as a provider test case; it does not prove production coverage for every plate.

entries.title: TecAlliance TecDoc Web Service official scope
entries.summary: Official product page states searches by vehicle details, VIN, VRM or OE part number and links products to vehicles; licensing/access and Portuguese coverage still need confirmation.

entries.title: JM delivered-cost calculator
entries.summary: Protected POST /shopping/landed-cost ranks offers with a verified delivered total only when shipping, tax treatment, customs and coupon state are explicit. Missing evidence leaves total null and records missing components.

entries.title: TelePeças API — stock, vehicle lookup and parts integration
entries.summary: Official API portal says APIs are free and offers sandbox/production. Marketing page documents GET /v1/stock/search?q=... with Bearer token and claims stock search, OEM/IAM compatibility, plate/VIN identification, quotes/orders and webhooks. A protected JM adapter now exposes stock search; live credentials/permissions still need verification.

entries.title: CarAPI.app Portugal plate-to-VIN
entries.summary: Official docs list Portugal (PT) as supported and describe returning year, make, model and VIN. Current plate credits: $4/10, $35/100, $150/500, $250/1000 ($0.25-$0.40 per lookup). Test registrations are documented for US/Canada/UK, not Portugal; no free Portugal test confirmed.

entries.title: eBay Browse API
entries.summary: Official API supports listing search by keyword/GTIN/product/compatibility and item-level compatibility checks. Requires application access token; use as a global marketplace source, not a fitment guarantee. Verify production access, Portugal shipping details and seller terms before implementation.

entries.title: SerpApi Google Shopping API
entries.summary: Official API supports Portugal localization, price filters and free-shipping search filter; cached exact queries are free and not counted. Search results indicate a 250-search/month free tier; paid Starter is $25/month for 1,000 searches. Results do not prove checkout price, stock, shipping or VAT.

entries.title: Render Free service limitations
entries.summary: Official docs: free web services spin down after 15 minutes idle, take about a minute to restart, have ephemeral local files, and share 750 free instance-hours per workspace/month; free Postgres expires after 30 days. Suitable for prototype/testing, not guaranteed always-on production.

entries.title: JM TelePeças stock search adapter
entries.summary: Feature branch adds protected GET /shopping/telepecas?q=... with optional maxPrice. Requires TELEPECAS_API_TOKEN. Results are normalized to reference/price/condition, but shipping, tax and final delivered cost remain unknown unless independently verified.
